what: Behind the sky-colored panel sits a blurred circle bigger than the screen (diameter 120vw · blur 30vw · blurred accent color). Wherever the cursor moves on screen, the circle’s center follows the cursor by .1 of the remaining distance per frame — the background slowly brightens and ripples with the hand. It rests when the panel is off screen

options.[data-fx-part=blob]: Light blob (child) — centered on the cursor position in screen coordinates, relative to the panel’s top left
options.--fx-top: Top offset reference (set via style), default 0 — if the panel extends above the screen, gives a top-edge offset such as 50% of the panel height (wandy hero)

note: On touch devices (hover false) and reduced-motion settings it stays parked at screen center

from.where: index.html .w-gradient (Hero·review strip·contact panel — a #D9EBF5 circle over a #8EC4E2 background, layering a gradient blended at -10% over the panel with 10% grain)
